items.title: Wave Leaf Tile DXF Pattern for Contemporary Wall Screens
items.description: Stylized leaf-and-wave motifs repeat in neat rows across the panel, each unit curling gently into the next for a soft contemporary rhythm. The tidy tiled layout suits modern living rooms, restaurant partitions, and office dividers.
